meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Internet Radio's verified Google ad slot; other cleanup is best-effort
meta.notes: **Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out in desktop Chromium at https://www.internet-radio.com/. `ins.adsbygoogle` matched 2 nodes, including one visible 1140×280 ad slot; the rule also matched Google helper frames, including hidden frames. Cookie and app-banner selectors matched 0. `recipes/fixtures/internet-radio/desktop-live-selector.html` is a minimal fixture for the observed selector, not a page capture. Other routes and locales were not checked.
